english.title: Fail to stop a vehicle as directed by an accredited person while escorting load - Police Reform
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person

(A)_[driving]_
(B)_[propelling]_

a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), neglected or refused to stop the vehicle when directed to do so by a person accredited under the Police Reform Act 2002 engaged in the regulation of traffic on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), while escorting a

(C)_[vehicle]_
(D)_[vehicle and trailer]_

carrying a load of exceptional dimensions
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 9 of Schedule 5 to the Police Reform Act 2002, section 35(1)(a) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) The above offence relates to powers assigned to a community support officer under paragraph 12 of Schedule 4 to the Police Reform Act 2002.
(iii) See also other offence wordings in relation to the duties of accredited persons:-
H4915 - failed to give name and address to accredited person - relevant offence
H4943 - fail to give name/address to accredited person - act in anti-social manner
H4944 - contravene accredited person's requirement to surrender liquor
H4945 - contravene accredited person's requirement not to consume liquor
H4947 - drive vehicle - fail to proceed as directed by an accredited person while escorting load
H4948 - pedestrian fail to proceed as directed by an accredited person while escorting load
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant

(A)_[drove]_
(B)_[propelled]_

**(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) and failed to stop the vehicle as directed by an accredited person engaged in the regulation of traffic while escorting a load of exceptional dimensions being carried on a vehicle or trailer.

other.powersofarrest: An accredited person DOES NOT have a power of arrest or to detain - however as with any criminal offence a police officer may arrest without warrant.
other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
